description: Administrators only, and this one CHANGES things: answer one feature flag for one company, or for everyone with '*' — exactly what the console's Features screen does. 'enabled' is true (on), false (off — a decision that overrules everyone's answer for this company) or null (take the answer away, so the wider scope decides again: the company falls back to '*', '*' falls back to the declared default). A key that is not declared is refused with the list of keys that are: a flag is never invented by naming it. A company that does not live on this machine is refused too. The change is written to the company journal against the calling administrator, the same line the console writes, and reaches this machine's other processes within about 30 seconds. Answers with the flag read afterwards, as admin_list_feature_flags reads it for that scope: 'effective' and 'from'.

enabled.description: true for on, false for off, null to take this scope's answer away.

key.description: The flag's key, as admin_list_feature_flags lists it, e.g. 'assistant.stream'.

workspace.description: A company's slug ('acme' in acme.kaiku.tech), or '*' for everyone.

name: admin_set_feature_flag
title: Admin set feature flag
